name: Comment prompt: reply under the question
when: The voice asks the viewers a question and says to answer in the comments. Any shot with a lower-left corner free; the plates carry their own contrast, so it needs no dim.
anchor: The question types out in a name-tag plate when the voice starts asking it (`at`); on the word "comments" (`press`) a thread drops from it into an outlined reply plate that types the ask and leaves a caret.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.question: the question as the voice asks it, sentence case, 52 characters at most (one line)
vars.ask: the reply line, default Tell me in the comments, 32 characters at most
vars.at: seconds after the start: when the voice starts the question (normally 0)
vars.press: seconds after the start: when the voice says "comments"
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: nametag-A's plate holds a sentence-case question (46 px, typed in 12 frames because it is long). The reply is the same plate with a 2 px full-colour outline, indented 72 px and joined by a 4 px elbow thread. The caret breathes (soft fade) until the exit.
